name: Concealment Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can force your illusion magic item to hide you in multiple ways.

Prerequisite(s): Concealment Mastery.

You gain an additional daily use of Concealment Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level illusion (glamer) spell. This spell may have a level equal to 3 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
